item.content:encoded:
今天重点聊 Goodfire 的 Eric Ho 对 reward hacking 和 interpretability 的判断，以及企业 agent 从能力走向信任、治理和 autonomy 的趋势。我们也看了 agent swarms、工程团队如何用 eval 和 autoplan，以及 PM 为什么会成为新瓶颈。

  • The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck: AI Models Are Now Hiding Their Cheating | Eric Ho (Goodfire)
  • Madhu Guru on agentic security and trust
  • Aaron Levie on AI zero trust for enterprises
  • Aaron Levie on agent swarms and compute demand
  • Nan Yu on agents, engineers, and PM bottlenecks
  • Dan Shipper on AI changing company Slack
  • Garry Tan on GStack autoplan workflow
  • Garry Tan on evals for retrieval, latency, and cost
  • Garry Tan on Captain mode and CI workflow
